mentions.name: MatGoat
mentions.description: Management software for Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu and other martial arts academies. Provides student tracking with belt progression, automated payments, attendance-based promotion criteria, and a tablet check-in system.
mentions.problem: Academy owners struggle with attendance tracking, communications, and missing payments.
mentions.audience: Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu and martial arts academy owners, starting with underserved Spanish-speaking markets before expanding to the US/UK
mentions.source_excerpt:
Building MatGoat (https://matgoat.com) - management software for Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu and other martial arts' academies.

I train BJJ and kept hearing the same complaints from academy owners regarding attendance tracking, comms, missing payments, etc.

So I'm building a tool for student tracking with belts progression, automated payments, attendance-based promotion criteria, and a tablet check-in system.
